situation: The customer is at the counter of the corner cafe.
facts: Menu: americano, latte, cappuccino and muffin. The first-day quest drink costs 4 coins regardless of the drink ordered.
Coffee drinks can be hot or iced at the same price.
Drinks are available in small, medium and large sizes.
Milk can be regular or soy at no extra cost.
Customers can ask for an extra shot, no sugar or no ice. Do not invent a surcharge. Confirm their drink, milk and requested changes before finishing the order.
The restroom is at the back of the cafe.
The hotel is right across the main street: cross at the crosswalk outside the cafe door, turn left, and it is a few steps up on the corner.
